mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_group_mention_notice (group_id, message_id, sender_id, recipient_id) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{messageId}, #{senderId}, #{recipientId})
mapper.select: SELECT recipient_id FROM im_group_mention_notice WHERE message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY recipient_id

SELECT n.id, n.group_id, n.message_id, n.sender_id, g.name AS group_name, m.body, n.created_at, n.read_at FROM im_group_mention_notice n JOIN im_chat_group g ON g.id = n.group_id JOIN im_group_message m ON m.id = n.message_id JOIN im_group_member gm ON gm.group_id = n.group_id AND gm.user_id = n.recipient_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{userId} AND m.id > gm.joined_after_id AND n.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_group_mention_notice n JOIN im_group_member gm ON gm.group_id = n.group_id AND gm.user_id = n.recipient_id JOIN im_group_message m ON m.id = n.message_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{userId} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND m.id > gm.joined_after_id
mapper.update: UPDATE im_group_mention_notice n JOIN im_group_member gm ON gm.group_id = n.group_id AND gm.user_id = n.recipient_id JOIN im_group_message m ON m.id = n.message_id SET n.read_at = COALESCE(n.read_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE n.recipient_id = #{userId} AND n.id = #{id} AND m.id > gm.joined_after_id

UPDATE im_group_mention_notice n JOIN im_group_member gm ON gm.group_id = n.group_id AND gm.user_id = n.recipient_id JOIN im_group_message m ON m.id = n.message_id SET n.read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE n.recipient_id = #{userId} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND m.id > gm.joined_after_id
